name: LifelongAgentBench
intro: LifelongAgentBench是首个统一基准，系统评估大型语言模型智能体的终身学习能力。涵盖数据库、操作系统和知识图谱三大交互环境，支持自动标签验证、可复现性和模块化扩展。
org: South China University of Technology, MBZUAI, Chinese Academy of Sciences, East China Normal Univers
build_method: 原子技能驱动任务生成, 稀有技能概率增采样, 自动执行校验与10%人工复核
metric: 任务成功率, 分组自一致性投票
scale: 22项SQL技能, 29个Bash命令, 7种知识图谱操作
build_method_en: Atomic-skill-grounded generation, rare-skill probabilistic upsampling, execution verification and 10% manual review
intro_en: LifelongAgentBench is the first unified benchmark that systematically evaluates the lifelong learning ability of large language model agents. It covers three interactive environments: databases, operating systems, and knowledge graphs, supporting automatic label verification, reproducibility, and modular extensibility.
scale_en: 22 SQL skills, 29 Bash commands, and 7 knowledge-graph operations
metric_en: Task success rate, group self-consistency voting

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.11942v3, Sections 3–5. LifelongAgentBench defines 22 SQL skills, 29 Bash commands, and 7 knowledge-graph operations, then probabilistically upsamples rare skills while varying complexity, noise, overlap, and task dependency. DeepSeek-R1 turns sampled SQL skills into database tasks that run in fresh Dockerized MySQL instances and are checked by query-result comparison or database-state hashing; operating-system tasks reset Ubuntu containers and use task-specific Bash evaluators whose exit code must be zero; knowledge-graph tasks map GrailQA S-expressions to agent/SPARQL operations and verify returned outputs. A 10% task sample is manually reviewed. Unified agent-environment-controller APIs enforce strict sequential execution, and evaluation compares no replay with 1/4/8/16/32/64 recent successful trajectories plus group self-consistency majority voting.
